Gaussian envelope is e^{6N²}e^{-7|z|²/2}; translated center bounds prove compact C-infinity convergence and weighted T1 admissibility. Schatten p norms of the fixed blocks are summable for every p>1, while published trace-class heat estimate excludes p=1. Standalone exact rational checker passed 3160 assertions for N=2..16; infinite scope follows analytically, not from enumeration.

originality.rationale: The nonconstructive simultaneous all-S_p (p>1) endpoint example is published by Virtanen. Separately, Esmeral García–Maximenko, arXiv:2503.23276v1 Definition 3 and Lemma 4.2, construct precisely the individual Gaussian–Laguerre interpolation blocks and their binomial Toeplitz eigenvalues. Neither paper supplies the explicit signed parity-block trace-norm summation, preassigned separated spatial centers, amplitudes, and all-S_p endpoint divergence of the present claim. Looi constructs bounded-operator and heat-threshold examples but does not supply the simultaneous all-p>1 Toeplitz-ideal construction. Originality is restricted to this explicit endpoint assembly; known blocks and known abstract existence are credited.
residual_risks: The individual Gaussian–Laguerre blocks are known from arXiv:2503.23276v1. Other prior constructions may have already assembled them to solve the same all-S_p heat endpoint explicitly; this specific priority question is not independently resolved.
No independent exhaustive global publication-priority search; The mathematical record search is semantic rather than an exhaustive theorem index.
The existential endpoint separation is already settled by Virtanen; no novelty is claimed for it.

value.rationale: Virtanen proved an all-Schatten-p>1 critical heat counterexample only nonconstructively. Esmeral García–Maximenko published explicit radial Laguerre approximate projections, but only for a uniform eigenvalue approximation problem. Their quantitative trace-norm signed parity assembly plus explicit super-separated centers provide a single reproducible real smooth endpoint heat-divergent example with transparent summability in every p>1. The value is this concrete and verifiable bridging construction, not invention of Laguerre moments or a new existential endpoint theorem.
